[2026-08-26T02:05:38.081Z] [world] The flat silt heaves, and a hand breaks the surface, then an arm, then a face caked grey with a thousand years of it.
[2026-08-26T02:05:38.082Z] [arbiter] The traders were right. Aetherkin. Some kneel to them; some burn them where they stand.
[2026-08-26T02:05:38.082Z] [world] In life it was a child, no taller than your hip, one small hand closed around nothing — you find yourself wanting to know their name, and knowing you never will. They surfaced out of the flat mud like a held breath finally, terribly let go.

[2026-08-26T02:05:38.083Z] [world] It flinches from you and puts its back to the wall, hands raised — not a hunter, just something frightened that has forgotten everything except how to be afraid.
[2026-08-26T02:05:38.083Z] [world] You set out west. Your boots sink half an inch into the mud-flats and pull free with each step.
[2026-08-26T02:05:38.083Z] [world] The loose end is exactly as loose as you left it.
